rationale: Pulp standalone apps have no way to receive the files the OS asks them to open, so a Finder double-click or an 'open -a' on a project document launches the app and drops the path. This adds one virtual to WindowHost, set_open_files_handler, whose base implementation is a recorded unsupported-feature no-op; the macOS host implements it in its own translation unit and everything else inherits the no-op. The retained UI kernel is only the carrier: the routing decision lives in the app bundle's CFBundleDocumentTypes declaration and the delivery contract lives in StandaloneApp, neither of which is a Vellum slice. This is a Pulp-only platform-shell seam with no named immutable Vellum framework commit to backport; a Vellum-native retained UI should define its own document-open contract, including whether launch-time paths are held for a late handler, rather than copy this shape.
